hooks.name: Typecheck and test the engine on save
hooks.description: When a file under packages/engine is saved, run the engine typecheck and then the engine tests once, printing each exit code.

action.command: pnpm --filter @jacquard/engine typecheck; echo "TYPECHECK_EXIT_CODE=$?"; pnpm --filter @jacquard/engine test; echo "TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?"
